notes.title: Join us on our Discord!

Hello to all our new players,

We hope to see you there!

notes.title: Version 0.0.3 Release!
notes.notes:
We haven't been the best at updating the game but, fear not the updates are here! Since aren’t any conventions for us to attend in the near future, we will do our best to keep a steady update schedule from now on. Also we would love to hear feedback from the community so you can voice you opinion on our discord group here https://discord.gg/gdnVA9V  

[b] Changelog: [/b]
[list]
    [*][b]New 3D models for the Knights added.[/b] We were using ones that we are also selling in the unreal marketplace as placeholder so we needed to change them for the IP to be more unique.
    [*]Fixed Physical Asset for the Knights meaning that ragdoll and hit detection works better.
    [*]Fixed Tutorial buttons bugs, some buttons were not working as intended.
    [*][b]Changed the way the buttons work in the tutorial[/b], we heard loud and clear that the “buttons” didn’t look like buttons so we changed the way they are used.
    [*]Fixed barrier bugs. They can’t be called barriers if they were not blocking stuff properly can they?
    [*]Made tutorial button used for dominant hand spawn closer. We didn’t want you to hit your monitor by accident because you needed to move a little closer to the button. Sorry…
    [*][b]Added wisps to the survival mode.[/b] At some point the wisp spawning broke so we had to piece it together again.
    [*][b]New wisps design.[/b] They didn’t looked like enemies before, hopefully they now do.
    [*]Fixed wisps movement, they kept crashing in the walls. Can’t blame them because they don’t have eyes.
    [*][b]Fixed Knight get up logic.[/b] Some of the knights stayed in the ground after being knocked down so we told them to move their lazy ass.
    [*]Some debug primitives in the hand were hidden. Can’t be an immersive experience if some random sphere appears out of nowhere in the player hands.
[/list] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32231016/3b036d5fed43d9bc79bf03874d917adf8d90a2af.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.0.2 Release!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, this is our first update to the game, we have made some improvements to the way motion spells works so they should feel way more responsive and fun to use.
Also we learned how to package our game correctly so the download size should be smaller now!

We are also working on new enemies that will be ready for a future release of the game.

Changelog:
- Changed how the motions are recognized
- Improved the responsiveness of the activation of the fire and ice motion spells
- Improved SFX in the fire and ice spells
- Added Voice Actress lines to the motion spells activation.
- Added missing haptic effects to spells

notes.title: Stage 3: Azaria now Available in Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32231016/77988fdf498ec80ce195a8e2d050b6b240eeb6ac.png[/img]

Stage 3: Azaria is now avaiable to download! We are super excited for all of you to try it and join us in the developement of this game.

The game is in a early stage of development and we will be updating it as we add new levels and new features like more magic spells, enemies and new challenges for you to face.

We hope you enjoy our game and stay with us as we build the world of Azaria!

notes.title: Stage 3: Azaria coming to Early Access this Friday!
notes.notes:
Stage 3: Azaria is coming on March 16th to Early Acess in Steam! We are super excited to share with you the work we have done in the last several months.

It's been a great experience to get the game to Early Acces and we think it will be even better with you joining us and getting involved in the development of the game.

If you have an HTC Vive you won't want to miss this game! There is a lot of content to be added in the coming months so make sure to keep updated with the Store Page updates!
